JarvanIV|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter-tank, an early gank and engage specialist. Demacian Standard (E) plants a flag, Dragon Strike (Q) strikes in a line and, if it reaches the flag, pulls him to it and knocks up everything in his path: that's the E-Q combo. Golden Aegis (W) gives a shield and slows, Cataclysm (R) traps enemies in an arena, and his passive deals percent-health damage on the first attack on each target.
JarvanIV|jgl.playstyle: Early-game engage jungler: ganks from level 3 with E-Q, dives and teamfight engages with his ultimate. He has to build his lead early.
JarvanIV|jgl.early_game: Clear fast, then gank at level 3 with E-Q, which knocks up and closes the gap: one of the best early ganks. Also use E-Q to go over walls and escape ganks. Control Scuttle and invade when your laners have priority.
JarvanIV|jgl.level_1: Demacian Standard (E) first. The flag gives nearby allies attack speed and armor.
JarvanIV|jgl.level_2: Dragon Strike (Q). E-Q: throw the flag, then Q toward it to launch yourself and knock up. It's your gank and mobility tool.
JarvanIV|jgl.level_3: Golden Aegis (W). Shield and slow: E-Q to knock up, then W to stop the escape. A very strong first gank.
JarvanIV|jgl.level_6: Cataclysm: you leap onto a target and trap it in an arena. Use it to isolate a carry in teamfights or to stop an escape on a gank. You can recast it to destroy the arena.
power_spikes: Level 6: an arena to isolate a target.
First completed item: very strong ganks and engages.
JarvanIV|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear up to level 3, then gank the most favorable lane. Jarvan IV wants to build a lead early: ganks, invades with your laners, Scuttle control. Take Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons with a lane that has priority. Keep E-Q to escape if you get invaded.
JarvanIV|jgl.trading: Ganking: E-Q to knock up → W → attacks. Skirmishing: E-Q on several targets, then R on the carry to isolate it. Give up on it if your E-Q misses and your opponent has an escape.
threats: Junglers who beat him in duels (Rek'Sai, Wukong, Master Yi).
CC that interrupts you before E-Q.
Long games where your impact drops.
mistakes: Using your ultimate on a tank instead of a carry.
Locking your own team out with your ultimate.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You're both strong early: be faster on ganks.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in duels: gank where he isn't.
matchup_notes.Viego: Isolate him with your ultimate when he dives.
matchup_notes.Wukong: His clone fools you: save E-Q for the real Wukong.
matchup_notes.Master Yi: His Alpha Strike dodges your E-Q: cast it after his dash.

JarvanIV|jgl.mid_game: Engages and dives. Jarvan IV is great at starting fights around objectives.
JarvanIV|jgl.late_game: Teamfight engage: E-Q onto several targets, R on the carry. Wait until your team can follow.
JarvanIV|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler, dive with your laners and take objectives.
JarvanIV|jgl.behind: Look for picks with E-Q and play with your team.
JarvanIV|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to build an early lead through E-Q ganks, then engage teamfights with your ultimate.
JarvanIV|jgl.final_tip: Place your flag behind the target before casting Q: that's what knocks it up.
